decisions.reason: As a 2018 compilation CD in a mature physical-media segment, it likely now falls below aspiration levels relative to newer uses of shelf space, so we would reallocate resources.

Although its own-page presence in 2018 and 2019 suggests some initial acceptance, the older niche series format and limited evidence of continuing prominence make discontinuation more likely than not.
A 2019 jazz vinyl reissue fits a German niche-collector market with longer tails than standard CDs, so with uncertain but potentially acceptable performance we would keep it for now.
A multi-disc box set is typically a finite, capital-tieing product, and if results are no longer clearly above aspiration we would end it and shift resources elsewhere.
Because it was only mentioned rather than given its own page at launch, it appears to have had the weakest strategic commitment and most likely underperformed relative to aspiration levels.
